single.rationale: Ecolab demonstrates solid fundamental quality with improving margins (operating margin expanded from 11% to 17% over three years) and strong cash generation (FCF margin ~12%), but faces concerning deceleration in revenue growth (4.3% 3-year CAGR declining to 2.2% most recent year) and rich valuation (38x P/E, 42x P/FCF). The Ovivo Electronics acquisition signals strategic positioning in semiconductors, but near-term headwinds from tariffs, geopolitical uncertainty, and elevated capex intensity warrant monitoring before deeper commitment.
